registers.name: CTRL_ENABLE
registers.description: Enable bit for request generation and response processing.

fields.name: ENABLE
fields.description: When 1, the transport controller may issue requests and process responses. When 0, the controller cancels outstanding activity and enters safe fallback behavior.

fields.name: RESERVED
fields.description: Reserved; write as zero.

fields.name: MODE
fields.description: Operational mode selector forwarded to the transport FSM.

fields.name: RESERVED
fields.description: Reserved; write as zero.

registers.name: CTRL_VELOCITY_SETPOINT
registers.description: Vehicle velocity setpoint used in request generation.

fields.name: VELOCITY_SETPOINT
fields.description: Selected vehicle velocity setpoint encoded into outbound requests.

fields.name: RESERVED
fields.description: Reserved; write as zero.

registers.name: CTRL_FRESHNESS_TIMEOUT
registers.description: Freshness timeout in cycles for outstanding requests.

fields.name: TIMEOUT_CYCLES
fields.description: Maximum number of clock cycles allowed for a request to remain outstanding before timing out.

fields.name: RESERVED
fields.description: Reserved; write as zero.

fields.name: ACTUATOR_MIN
fields.description: Lower saturation bound for all emitted actuator commands.

fields.name: ACTUATOR_MAX
fields.description: Upper saturation bound for all emitted actuator commands.

registers.name: CTRL_SAFE_FALLBACK_CMD
registers.description: Safe fallback actuator command used when no valid response is available.

fields.name: SAFE_FALLBACK_CMD
fields.description: Deterministic safe command used on reset, disable, timeout, invalid response, malformed response, protocol error, or invalid configuration.

registers.name: CTRL_TX_ID_SEED
registers.description: Transaction ID seed loaded into the request counter.

fields.name: TX_ID_SEED
fields.description: Initial transaction ID value used after reset and for request transaction sequencing.

fields.name: RESERVED
fields.description: Reserved; write as zero.

registers.name: CTRL_GEOMETRY_FORMAT
registers.description: Geometry format selector; compact descriptor only.

fields.name: GEOMETRY_FORMAT
fields.description: Compact geometry format selector used in request packets.

fields.name: RESERVED
fields.description: Reserved; write as zero.

fields.name: REF_GEOMETRY_ENABLE
fields.description: When 1, the request packet indicates use of the DrivAerML reference geometry source.

fields.name: RESERVED
fields.description: Reserved; write as zero.

registers.name: STATUS_WORD0
registers.description: Status bits including busy, request outstanding, response accepted, stale rejected, clamp applied, fallback active, and protocol error.

fields.name: BUSY
fields.description: Controller is actively issuing a request, awaiting a response, or handling a transport transaction.

fields.name: REQ_OUTSTANDING
fields.description: A request has been issued and has not yet been completed or canceled.

fields.name: RESP_ACCEPTED
fields.description: A response was accepted on a valid and timely handshake.

fields.name: STALE_RESP_REJECTED
fields.description: A response was rejected because it was stale or outside the freshness window.

fields.name: CLAMP_APPLIED
fields.description: The emitted actuator command was saturated to the configured min/max window.

fields.name: FALLBACK_ACTIVE
fields.description: Deterministic safe fallback behavior is currently active.

fields.name: PROTOCOL_ERROR
fields.description: A protocol error, malformed response, ID mismatch, or invalid transaction condition has been detected.

fields.name: CONFIG_VALID
fields.description: Derived configuration validity; asserted only when scalar bounds and required control fields are consistent.

fields.name: RESERVED
fields.description: Reserved.

fields.name: LAST_ACCEPTED_TXID
fields.description: Transaction ID associated with the most recent accepted response.

fields.name: RESERVED
fields.description: Reserved.
